title: DataTable
intro: DataTable is often used table logic encapsulated component, it can save up some boilerplate setup from react-table & quick start with your async table data.
tables: The core columns configuration object for the entire table
The data array that you want to display on the table
Wheter to display loading indicator on the table
Callback when row checkbox is changed, return a checkbox value & changed row data
Callback when indeterminate checkbox is changed, return indeterminate checkbox value & all rows data
Callback when page size selector changed
Callback when any column of sorted changed, return sort order & sorted column identifier
Specify skeleton avatar display is which column when loading is true
